The '''Aleron Trade Cooperative''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleron]]. The Cooperative was made up of the world's prominent business leaders and although the companies involved nominally had equal say in governing, the representatives of [[Macander Heavy Ores]] generally dominated proceedings.<ref name="LE" />
